_comment: Inferno MCP server config. Copy the 'inferno' block into your MCP client's config (Claude Desktop: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json on macOS), then restart the client. Make sure the Inferno gateway + workers are running (scripts\run-all.bat). Edit the two absolute paths to match your machine.
